purpose: Validate the unbiased known-propensity estimator and freeze a future exploration-by-credit factorial without reinterpreting the negative Stage-C2 credit result.

claim_boundary.estimator: CPU exact enumeration of a binary reward-class reduction. This is not ReDCO and is not a language-model learning result.
claim_boundary.stage_c2: The failed mechanistic-credit-positive decision remains final. This diagnostic does not authorize another GPU campaign.
claim_boundary.proposal: Proposal sampling is a separately named exploration factor. It may not be added only to a ReDCO arm.

estimator_contract.baseline: For sample i, the arithmetic mean of importance-weighted rewards from samples j != i.
estimator_contract.support: epsilon is strictly below 1, so q(a)>0 whenever pi(a)>0.
prohibited: forced inclusion represented as if sampled from pi
post-hoc epsilon selection for a GPU claim

grid.enumeration: All 2^11 action groups for every grid row; no Monte Carlo.

mandatory_checks.failure: Record the failure without changing the estimator or tolerance.

reported_diagnostics: expected informative groups per optimizer step
variance ratio to the on-policy estimator
exact target gradient, estimator mean, and maximum absolute bias

exploration_levels: shared declared mixture proposal with known propensities
future_factorial.crossing: Every exploration level is crossed with every credit level.
future_factorial.broadcast_equivalent: At a proposal level, broadcast samples the same target decision from q and applies the same known pi/q correction; only the credit method differs.
future_factorial.next_gpu_run: None is authorized by this preregistration. Any future run needs a new protocol justified against the Stage-C2 negative result.
